items.content_html: PhantomPad is a weekend side-project that turns your smartphone into a wireless PC game controller. It uses a lightweight Node.js server and WebSockets to transmit multi-touch inputs over local Wi-Fi. By integrating with the ViGEmBus driver, it authentically emulates a real Xbox 360 controller with zero latency and full joystick support!
